name: Mogis, God of Slaughter
oracle_text:
Indestructible
As long as your devotion to black and red is less than seven, Mogis isn't a creature.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, Mogis deals 2 damage to that player unless they sacrifice a creature of their choice.
blocked_sentences: As long as your devotion to black and red is less than seven, Mogis isn't a creature.

needs.what: a static value for devotion to two colours (rule 700.5a): the number of mana symbols in the mana costs of permanents you control that are black OR red, where a hybrid {B/R} pip counts once, not twice -- e.g. mana_symbols accepting a list `of: ["B", "R"]` that counts each pip at most once if it contains any listed colour
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_symbols takes a single colour in `of` (validate_mana_symbols refuses anything else), and summing mana_symbols of B plus mana_symbols of R double-counts every {B/R} hybrid pip because symbols_of in engine/mana.py counts a hybrid pip for each of its colours; no static value subtracts hybrid pips, so the God would become a creature too early
